evidence_roles.definition: Defines or analyzes concepts, formal properties or explanatory theory.
Defines a computational or analytical method, assumptions, operations or complexity.
Provides component, boundary, interface, lifecycle or deployment structure evidence.
Provides normative requirements or controlled vocabulary from an identified standards authority.
Reports observations, experiments, benchmarks or measured outcomes relevant to a bounded claim.
Provides evidence about human work, cognition, accessibility, interaction, safety or organizational behavior.
Defines authority, accountability, assurance, policy, risk, privacy, security or audit obligations.
Helps falsify merge, split, demotion, externalization or ownership decisions for a product boundary.
Shows a candidate independently operated product, project or organization associated with a related job or capability.
Describes a concrete provider, project, API, runtime or technical implementation.
Explicit debt when committed metadata cannot defensibly assign a narrower controlled role.
not_sufficient_for: any semantic, implementation, qualification or acceptance gate

exact_support_requires: recoverable source representation or source-state identifier
validator-confirmed match to the bounded claim
gate_laws: Research proposal may prepare evidence and decisions but may not mint semantic authority.
Semantic ratification requires a named authority decision over an exact editioned payload.
Implementation qualification requires reproducible implementation evidence against an exact contract scope.
Executed acceptance requires a physical occurrence and acceptance receipt for the declared vertical and environment.
One gate does not imply another unless an explicit editioned contract says so.
negative_charter: Does not define product or bounded-context semantics.
Does not promote an organization, brand, product, project or foundation into a canonical product.
Does not infer legal identity, acquisition, rename, parentage, control or succession from names, domains or shared branding.
Does not treat a homepage or resource URL as proof of a bounded capability or adoption claim.
Does not treat an independent implementation as semantic authority.
Does not convert a proposed evidence role into semantic ratification.
Does not invent implementation qualification or executed vertical acceptance.
Does not require optional AI or agent functionality.

bounded_claims: Provenance can distinguish entities, activities and agents.
Qualified influence relations can carry attributes such as role, time and plan.
non_authority_scope: Does not identify which Shannon product owns a meaning.
Does not validate the truth of a source claim.
Does not equate provenance attribution with legal or semantic ownership.
primary_sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology

bounded_claims: Selectors can identify a segment of a source using fragments, exact text or positions.
A source state can identify the intended representation of a changing resource.
non_authority_scope: A selector does not prove that the selected passage supports the claim.
The model does not ratify evidence roles or product boundaries.
primary_sources.title: Web Annotation Data Model

bounded_claims: Versioned resources can use typed version and succession relations.
Resource identity and version succession should be explicit rather than inferred from titles.
non_authority_scope: Resource-version relations do not establish corporate acquisition, legal parentage or semantic ownership.
DataCite metadata does not qualify an implementation.
primary_sources.title: DataCite Metadata Schema and Versioning Guidance

bounded_claims: LEI reference data can provide who-is-who information for legal entities within the Global LEI System.
non_authority_scope: Not every organization, project, product, brand or foundation has an LEI.
An LEI identifies a legal entity, not every product or project it operates.
primary_sources.title: Level 1 Data: Who is Who

bounded_claims: The Global LEI System represents direct and ultimate accounting-consolidating parent relationships for reporting legal entities.
Relationship records include typed relationship, dates, validation and reporting information.
non_authority_scope: Accounting-consolidation parentage is not a universal acquisition, brand, product or semantic-ownership model.
Missing LEI relationship data does not prove that no relationship exists.
primary_sources.title: Level 2 Data: Who Owns Whom

role_assignment_laws: A role applies to a source-claim binding, not permanently to a source.
A source may serve different roles for different bounded claims.
Heuristic role projections remain proposed and unratified.
Independent products and organizations are adoption evidence, never default semantic authority.
Unknown role is explicit debt and must not be coerced to architecture or theory.
sovereign_question: What evidence entity, bounded claim, locator, role and gate state may the horizontal research corpus assert without confusing adoption, provenance, semantic authority, implementation qualification or executed acceptance?
